tw.description:
Pixel Miner 是一款像素挖礦冒險遊戲，沒有廣告、沒有內購、沒有等待，完全離線也能玩。

基特為什麼這麼想一直挖下去？每次都帶回更多礦石，升級鑽掘機挖出更多礦物，還要一路鋪鐵路……究竟要通往哪裡？

只要一根手指，就能幫基特在地底深處找到驚人的礦物和隱藏的寶藏。接下合約，領取報酬。每座新礦坑都更深，藏著更奇特的石頭。

回到地面後，你可以：

• 用更快的鑽頭、更大的油箱和更亮的燈升級鑽掘機
• 把車站從木板小屋擴建成熱鬧的火車站
• 改善每座礦坑，讓每次下礦走得更遠
• 開行火車，運回額外的礦石

但你會漸漸發現有些事情不太對勁：一座滿是舊工具和紀錄的廢棄礦坑、峽谷對岸燈火已熄的小鎮，還有在最深處等待著的某個東西。

特色：

• 一根手指就能操作
• 幾分鐘空檔就能玩完一趟
• 精美的像素美術
• 一段一段親手鋪起的鐵路
• 每趟都有合約，買家越熟越肯出高價
• 附專屬排行榜的每週挑戰礦坑
• 收集化石、遺物和稀有發現，在火車站展示
• 鑽掘機的塗裝、貼花和喇叭
• Game Center 成就與排行榜
• 支援 iCloud 存檔

玩幾分鐘或一整晚都行，看看這座山谷有多深……還有，最後是誰在等著你。

tw.description:
每一次附魔都是一場賭博。絕大多數會讓你變得更強。有些則會徹底改變整個世界。

Enchanted Survival 是一款生存 roguelite 遊戲。武器會自動射擊，因此你唯一能控制的就是站位，以及要附魔和升級的項目。每波攻勢之間戰鬥會停止，你走向一座發光的祭壇，獻上從死者身上拾取的水晶，並在毫不知情的情況下祈求一項附魔。

大多數附魔會強化一件裝備。接著一雙靴子獲得了凍足，你身旁戰鬥的湖泊在腳下徹底凍結成冰，而原本永遠無法抵達的半邊地圖，成了你在該局剩餘時間裡戰鬥的所在。

涵蓋多種裝備的 650 種以上附魔。為更深層的儀式付出代價，稀有結果出現的機率就會提高，偶爾還會同時出現兩個。線索會提示你這場儀式正偏向何種結果。

保留所得，或放手一搏
透過三個階級來強化附魔。在鐵砧上下注水晶來淬鍊裝備並提升其數值，然後看著進度條跑動卻不知道它會停在何處。抽離附魔以騰出插槽。這一切都使用相同的水晶來支付，而這些水晶原本可以用於進行新的抽取。

各自反擊的十個關卡
環繞湖泊而建的草甸。由金字塔與一座綠洲構成的沙漠。冰川盆地、火山原野、蘑菇沼澤、風暴高原、燈塔海岸、沉沒遺跡、水晶洞窟。其中部分關卡會陷入黑暗，光芒將成為你必須攜帶、放置並隨侍在旁的物品。

玩法各異的三位英雄
冒險者，以遊戲最初設計的方式開局。漁夫，在開闊水域中游泳而不會溺水，但為了這項特權會被追得更快。遊俠，以弓箭起手並將每場儀式提升一個階級。

攜帶一件物品繼續前進
通關一個關卡，一件裝備中的物品就會隨你進入之後的每一局遊戲。完成一局會結算碎片，道路起點的攤位能將碎片轉化為第二把武器、更好的初始裝備，或是等級比你付費時深一個階級的第一個儀式。

特色
- 超過 650 種附魔，每一種都有清晰可見的效果
- 附魔、強化、淬鍊與抽離，全靠單一貨幣
- 精英怪、小頭目與頭目會阻擋攻勢推進，直到被擊倒為止
- 黑暗關卡中，光芒是你必須自行攜帶之物
- 隨著遊玩進度逐漸填滿的典籍與怪物圖鑑
- 單手拇指操作、橫向螢幕、專為手機打造
- 八種語言
- 單次買斷。無廣告、無應用程式內購買、完全支援離線遊玩

tw.releaseNotes: Digline 的內容越來越多囉！有傳言說，從你鄰居家再往左走，來了一位神秘的新人物。他還帶來了一大堆實驗，等你在鑽機上試一試。至少有幾個應該會成功……大概吧。
tw.description:
《Digline》是一款輕鬆上手的鑽探遊戲。每一次向地下深入，都是一場在進度與風險之間的抉擇，而真正的獎勵，總藏在更深的地底。

每次探險都從你的工坊開始。選擇裝備，駕駛燃料有限、設備簡陋的鑽探機出發。開鑿屬於自己的路線，穿越不斷變化的地層，決定要收集哪些資源，並在燃料耗盡前，思考該升級什麼、交易什麼。

每一次下潛，都可能發現新的材料、更稀有的礦物，以及地底深處意想不到的規律。原本只是單純的挖掘，逐漸演變成探索、效率與時機掌握之間的巧妙平衡。

回到地面後，持續優化你的策略，讓每一次探險都更有效率：

• 升級鑽頭、燃料容量與鑽探效率
• 解鎖價值更高、埋藏更深的新材料
• 規劃最佳路線，讓每一次下潛都收穫滿滿

你的進度會穩定累積，但每一次探險都充滿張力。太過保守，就會錯失珍貴資源；冒險太深，則可能失去一切。

打造屬於自己的探勘節奏：快速有效率的短程挖掘、高風險高報酬的深層探險，或穩紮穩打，逐步征服地底世界。

曾登上美國、英國休閒遊戲排行榜前 10 名，以及德國、挪威等多國前 5 名。現在就加入這場挖掘冒險吧！

原本只是尋找資源的旅程，卻漸漸變得更加神秘。你挖出的隧道會永久保留，地圖會隨著探索不斷擴展，而地下世界也開始不像隨機生成，更像是一個擁有自己歷史的地方。

《Digline》設計理念就是容易上手、適合利用零碎時間遊玩，同時又能帶來長期的成就感。快速開挖、短程探險，享受源源不絕的輕鬆樂趣。

特色：

• 直覺式單指直向操作
• 每次探險只需一、兩分鐘，隨時都能遊玩
• 永久保留的地下隧道，以及持續擴展的地圖
• 多個地下區域，各自擁有不同的資源、危險與驚喜
• 收集資源，用於製作升級與更完善的探險準備
• 工坊系統，讓每一次成功探險都化為永久成長
• 市場交易系統，出售帶回來的資源
• 跨越多次遊戲持續累積的成長，而非單次探險
• 寧靜舒適的氛圍，搭配充滿探索感的地下世界
• 無廣告，無內購，沒有任何付費才能獲勝的機制
• 成就系統與「每日挖掘」排行榜競賽

挖得越深，礦坑揭露的秘密就越多。

Preserve the moments that matter most by turning printed photos, slides, negatives, and treasured keepsakes into a digital library your family can revisit and share for generations.

Using advanced AI technology, Photomyne brings old photos into the digital age, making it quick and simple to scan, restore, enhance, and organize your family’s memories.

Photo Scan Plus is the paid one-time purchase version of Photomyne. It includes the complete experience on your device: unlimited scanning, editing, saving, sharing, and organization on your iPhone or iPad. Add a Photomyne Membership anytime for secure cloud backup, web access, and syncing across your devices.

In addition to Photo Scan Plus, we also offer *Photo Scan by Photomyne*. It's free to download and is first to include our newest features, improvements, and innovations. Choose the app that you feel fits you best.

SCAN FASTER - PHOTOMYNE DOES THE REST
• Scan multiple printed photos in a single shot
• Digitize entire photo albums in minutes

us.description:
"Nothing is created, nothing is lost, everything is transformed." - Antoine Lavoisier, 'Elements of Chemistry'

The first 5 stages are free to play, and you can access all stages via an in-app purchase. Existing paid users retain full access to all content at no additional cost..

'Alcyone' is a chemistry puzzle game set across the periodic table. Your goal is to weave scattered elements together to synthesize molecules, and assemble them to trigger chemical reactions. Molecules don't simply stay in place. As temperatures rise and fall, matter changes states between gas, liquid, and solid—floating up or sinking down. This unique system adds depth to the puzzle in a truly distinctive way. Design your own chain reactions and lose track of time in the world of chemistry. Simply enjoy the game, and real-world chemical knowledge will follow like a gift.

Build molecules and trigger reactions.

• Combine elements to synthesize a wide variety of molecules. Experience the vast world of chemistry and find joy in discovering over 1,300 real-world compounds.
• Compounds change through three phases—solid, liquid, and gas—depending on the ambient temperature. Their physical properties, where solids and liquids sink and gases rise, act as key variables in your puzzles.
• Place identical compounds in adjacent cells to trigger reactions. The more complex the elemental composition of the compound, the higher the score you earn, allowing you to find your own efficient scoring path.
• Your score increases exponentially as the number of reacting compounds grows and the chain reactions last longer. Strategize your placement to achieve the highest possible scores.
• From basic reactions like acid-base neutralization and hydrolysis to advanced organic chemistry, combine real-world chemical reactions to design and enjoy spectacular chain reactions.

Explore the periodic table and collect elements.

• Conquering numerous stages organized by atomic number, from Hydrogen (H, 1) to Krypton (Kr, 36), allows you to explore chemistry from basic to advanced levels step-by-step.
• Every time you complete a stage, you can collect new elements or unlock new chemical reactions that expand the possibilities of your experiments and your scientific toolkit.
• Upgrade each element to significantly boost your scoring efficiency. As you upgrade specific elements, the value of every compound containing them increases, letting you reach much higher scores.
• Acquire and upgrade organic functional groups to improve synthesis efficiency. Even compounds with complex structures can be created much more easily and quickly using upgraded functional groups.

Alcyone is continuously improved through regular updates. Focus entirely on the joy of chemistry, with no pop-up ads.

us.releaseNotes: Lead Japan's merchant fleet to import resources and export goods!
us.description:
Lead Japan's merchant fleet to import resources and export goods!
Engage in trade, power up domestic industries, and drive the rapid growth of the Japanese economy!

Japan relies on imports for many of its essential resources, with 99% of these shipments transported by merchant vessels such as tankers and bulk carriers.
Imported resources are processed domestically into various goods for export, generating foreign currency. Merchant ships—including container ships and car carriers—play a vital role in these exports as well.

Building a merchant ship can take two to three years or more; consequently, many shipping companies secure the vessels they operate by leasing them from shipowners (a practice known as "chartering").


Use your merchant fleet to handle imports and exports, activate key domestic industries, and fuel the growth of the Japanese economy!
There are just two main tasks for the player:

1.
Charter merchant ships! You can sign contracts by selecting the charter period, ship type, and vessel size. Once chartered, simply choose your trading partners and the goods to be traded, and the ships will set sail.

2.
Operate essential domestic industries! By supplying valuable resources to these industries, you can manufacture products. These goods can be consumed domestically or sold as exports to earn foreign currency. Infrastructure that generates energy cannot be allowed to stop; oil, LNG (liquefied natural gas), and coal are vital to the Japanese economy. Make sure to keep imports flowing!


It’s "Game Over" if you run out of any of the essentials for infrastructure and daily life: oil, LNG, coal, food, or money. Keep a close eye on your resource stockpiles as you manage the Japanese economy!


There are absolutely no advertisements or in-app purchases—feel free to focus entirely on the gameplay.

us.releaseNotes: Run Japan's trains!
us.description:
Run Japan's trains!

No railroad knowledge is required to play "Tokyo Train!".
This game is a brain game with simple rules but requires a lot of brain power.


Customers are waiting at the station for the trains to arrive to take them to their destinations.
Start the trains and transport your customers.

You will earn money for every passenger who boards a train.
Adjust the interval between runs and the number of cars to achieve the highest revenue.
Departing trains costs money. If you send out too many trains and the boarding rate drops, you will lose your revenue.

The operation method is very easy and the rules are simple.
All you have to do is adjust the number of train cars and make the trains depart at the best time.
As the game progresses, express fares will also appear.

No technical knowledge is required at all.
Both people who like trains and people who like games can quickly understand and enjoy the game.

There are no in-app purchases. There are no ads.
Please concentrate on the game.
Share your operating results on social media.

us.description:
OVERVIEW

	— ADVANCED RAW: Unlock the power of Apple's RAW engine with easy-to-use controls. Develop images with the same outstanding RAW processing in Apple’s Aperture professional photo app. Unique adjustments let you improve your images in ways that can't be done in any other app. 

	— ORGANIZE: RAW Power is a complete photo app to organize and manage your photo library. Fully compatible with iCloud Photo Library, so all changes are synced. Every image and every change is available to every app on your iPhone or iPad.

	— RATE & FILTER: Filter albums by file type, rating, flag, and edit state. Ratings and Flags sync over iCloud Photo Library!

	— FILES.APP: Store images in the Photos library or Files.app. Use our new Share extension to import from other apps directly into RAW Power’s Files container. Same non-destructive editing, rating, and filtering features! (iCloud syncing is not supported).

	— NOT JUST RAWs: RAW Power is great with JPEGs, with many tools missing from the Photos app. Plus an innovative Depth Effect for photos shot on iPhones with a dual camera system. 

	— EDIT CROSS-PLATFORM: Edit on iOS and continue on the Mac (or vice-versa) using RAW Power 3 for macOS. 
	— BATCH PROCESSING: Apply presets, paste adjustments, and export multiple images. Export to the photo library or to Files.app.

Using iOS 16 or later? You may be interested in Nitro Photo. It includes masking, XMP support, synchronized Pan and Zoom and many other features. Search for 'Nitro Photo' on the App Store.

ORGANIZATION AND DISPLAY

	— Zoom up to 800% for extremely precise adjustments.

	— Create and rename albums, delete images from albums and the library, and move images into albums. Full access to your folder hierarchy.

	— Display file name, exposure information, flash status, and location with a map.

REAL-TIME EDITING

	— Full non-destructive editing. All changes stored in the iOS Photo Library and iCloud Photo Library, so you can edit on one device and continue on another, without loss of quality. Even between Mac and iOS!

	— Optimized for small screens. Choose which adjustments to show by default and in what order

	— Unparalleled highlight recovery with Boost and Recovery sliders. Real-time control of Apple's RAW engine, including Noise Reduction, Black Point, Gamut Mapping and more

	— Auto Enhance, Auto White Balance, Auto Levels and Auto Curves. Apply them to multiple images at once!

	— Apply presets, and Copy / Paste Adjustments to one image or many

	— Histogram with Clipping Indicators and Hot Pixels Overlay

	— LUTs (Look up tables) with built-in looks and film simulations. Add your own!

	— Crop and Straighten, Rotate and Flip, White Balance with sampler and auto 

	— Highlights, Shadows, Vibrancy, Local Contrast and incredible Lighten and Darken sliders

	— Curves and Levels. Curves has Linear and Lab modes, and samplers

	— Depth Effect to enhance photos shot with the dual camera system

	— Chromatic Aberration to correct lens artifacts, Perspective, Black & White, Vignette with a controllable center point

	— All sliders are real-time and GPU accelerated

	— High-precision, deep color imaging engine

	— Export JPEG, PNG, and TIFFs (8- and 16-bit) to Files.app or Photos.app


COMPATIBILITY

	— Compatible with hundreds of cameras, including iPhone RAW images. (EXTENDED SUPPORT REQUIRES iOS 14. Full List at https://www.gentlemencoders.com/extended-raw/index.html) RAW support is downloaded in the background by Apple. Your device must be on WiFi and plugged in to get updates.

	— Great with JPEGs, TIFFs, PNGs, and most DNGs

	— Video Tutorials (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC7l78rOzFxaHG-e5AT-MGWQ)


RAW POWER for MAC

RAW Power is also available on the Mac App Store as a Photos Extension and standalone app with Photos Library support. Rated 4.5 stars worldwide!


ABOUT GENTLEMEN CODERS

Gentlemen Coders was founded by a former Senior Director of Engineering at Apple. For more information, visit www.gentlemencoders.com.

us.description:
Deck-Building JRPG "SOULVARS" is now available!

15-20 hours of playtime (+50h to go deeper)
Dynamic pixel animation and battles and a rich customization system

No In-App Purchases. 

While having a deep strategic sense, the vertically held smartphone controls allow for simple and exhilarating battles, training, dungeon exploration, and collection of random enchanted items.

▼ Story
A world line in which even the fictitious concept of the soul can be converted into data.
In return, people's lives are threatened by the sudden appearance of deformities.
The protagonists use the Soul Driver, a device that converts souls into data.
They are responsible for the elimination of the deformities that threaten people, and work in a certain town...

▼System Overview
Number of save slots: 3 (Saved in device and manual save)
Estimated scenario completion time: 14 to 20 hours
50 to 100+ hours of post-clearance challenge

Features
Soul bits (handbills), which are the data of the soul power that resides in gear (equipment),
Players can combine them in battle to make special attacks and combos in a successive manner. 
The characters are characterized by their action with dots that move around.

▼Gear and Soul Bits
Soul bits (hand cards) can be drawn from gear (equipment) and used as actions during battle.
The combination of main weapon, subweapon, armor, and accessories
Strategy (deck) is determined.

▼Arts
During a battle, only one soul bit can be selected on the first turn, but
The number of soul bits that can be selected at one time increases depending on the opponent's weaknesses, guarding, evading, buffing, debuffing, and various other conditions.
The combination of soul bits (cards in hand) selected at the same time activates a skill called Arts.

Traverse the dungeon in this awesome action / bullet-hell roguelite where every choice could make or break your run. Stack over 130 different items and create powerful synergies to become truly overpowered with 13 unique characters!

Balance risk and reward as your make your choices! Push your luck to grow your build, but don't overestimate your abilities, or your run could end on the spot. Navigate the dungeon wisely and reap the rewards to optimize your build to crush the dungeon with 13 unique characters!

BECOME OVERPOWERED

FIND SECRETS
Uncover the secrets of the dungeon on your quest to slay the Villain to unlock hidden paths, uncover new items, and grow your band of adventurers! And for those who crave a challenge, the greatest rewards are locked behind the greatest trials!

PLAY WITH FRIENDS

Photomator is the most powerful photo editing app ever designed for a mobile device. It includes an extensive collection of cutting-edge color adjustments, automatic selections powered by AI, support for over 750 RAW image formats, a magical Repair tool for removing unwanted objects, and many more powerful features, letting you enjoy pro photo editing anyplace, anytime.

Everything you need to make your photos look incredible
• Edit photos using a wide collection of powerful, nondestructive color adjustments
• Quickly make precise subject, sky, and background selections in photos using AI, add gradient masks, and easily make selections using a brush
• Effortlessly remove unwanted objects using an incredible object removal tool
• Crop, straighten, rotate, and adjust the perspective of photos with an easy-to-use Crop tool
• Instantly increase the resolution of photos using AI
• Remove camera noise and image compression artifacts with the powerful Denoise feature
• Magically remove color banding and increase color depth in photos with the AI-powered Smart Deband feature
• Make your photos stand out with photographer-designed presets for landscape, black and white, and other photography styles
• Easily copy and paste edits between photos or batch edit even hundreds of photographs at a time
• Open and edit over 750 RAW image formats, including Apple ProRAW and compressed Fujifilm RAWs
• Follow all the changes you make in the beautiful live histogram

Tools powered by AI
• Select the subject, sky, or background in a photo with just a tap
• Improve the quality of photos by reducing camera noise with the AI-powered Denoise feature, intelligently upscale photos with Super Resolution, or magically remove color banding and increase color depth using Smart Deband
• Automatically enhance shots using a machine learning algorithm trained on 20 million pro photos, or fine-tune individual adjustments, like White Balance, Selective Color, or Color Balance with a single tap

• Copy the look of any photo to another using the incredible Match Colors feature

State-of-the-art color adjustments
• Enjoy powerful tools for effortlessly adjusting the temperature, tint, exposure, contrast, brightness, hue, saturation, and vibrance in your photos
• Recover incredible amounts of detail in the highlights and shadows of photos
• Magically enhance fine details and structure in photos using powerful Clarity and Texture adjustments, or adjust textures in the highlights, midtones, and shadows separately

• Create beautiful black and whites even from your color photos
• Use a range of additional adjustments, like Sharpen, Fade, Grain, Color Monochrome, Sepia, and Invert to make your photos stand out
• Instantly change the look of photos with LUTs or export custom LUTs to use in other apps

Compatibility
• Automatically sync every change back to your Photos or Files browser
• With the support for iCloud Drive, enjoy seamless edit syncing across Mac, iPhone, and iPad

== Repeatedly recommended as Game of the Day in the App Store. ==

A shattered alien world. A squad of 3 Hunters. Real-time combat where every element counts.
Will you be the hunter—or the hunted? Your battles decide the fate of the planet!

When the planet broke apart, the survivors fled to the orbital "Ring," longing for the Home they lost. Now the Hunters return to the world below—fighting across its ruined continents for survival, for hope, and for a future worth saving.

GAME FEATURES
- Real-time squad action — Control 3 Hunters at once for fast, exhilarating combat.
- Elemental combos — Burn with Fire, Freeze with Ice, or fuse "Fire + Ice" into "Water" to drench your prey. The tactics are yours.
- No limits, ever — No "Energy," no "Stamina." Explore and gather resources for as long as you like.
- Bizarre prey & giant bosses — Hunt notorious Hooligans, low-flying octopuses and twist-dancing sandworms… and pray you never meet the legendary "Giant Hand."
- 8+ Hunters, each with a story — Build a crew of unforgettable misfits and gear them up your way.
- Gear & set builds — Mix equipment, trigger set bonuses, and craft your perfect team combo. A great Hunter always has more than one trick.
- Refined retro pixel art — A gorgeous, hand-crafted alien world in classic pixel style.

The whole planet is your hunting ground. Grab your squad and move out, Hunter!

------ A Word from the Developers ------
It's been 5 years since our last game, "Brutal Street 2." Creating something new—while staying true to what came before—was anything but easy. "Home, Planet & Hunters" is a labor of love from all of us, and we truly hope you enjoy it.
— The 12 friends at Black Pearl Games

这是一款国风武侠模拟建造游戏，已经在Steam平台销售超过10万份，好评率达到88%。在游戏中，你穿越回古代江城，建造现代工厂、架设传送带、邂逅形形色色的古人，触发精彩故事。一边生产建厂、习武打怪，一边周旋于商贾、侠客、皇室之间，打造属于自己的工业帝国。

自动化生产流水线
创建属于你的自动化生产线，从木板到电路板，设计每一条生产路径。逐步解锁未来科技——从硅提纯到光伏发电，建设你的超时代工坊。
酿酒榨油、制造烤箱，甚至是手表和抗生素——用你的未来商品惊艳古人！钢筋混凝土、橡胶、大型计算机，这些都将会是你在一千年前的古代批量建造的！

结交古人，谈一场跨越千年的恋爱
目前已开放12位可攻略角色——皇家、江湖、商家……解开每个人的秘密，追逐你想要的友情与爱情。
与你选择的伴侣谈婚论嫁，一同住进工坊，他/她也将成为你的强大助力。与近30位古人结交，每个人都有自己四季变化的日程，参与他们的人生，用现代知识解决他们的难题。

习武闯荡，称霸江湖
上手极快的战斗系统，闪躲与进攻，在合理操作中战胜你的敌人。正统学习或江湖奇遇——外功、内功、轻功、硬功，40余种武功让你称霸江湖！

开放大地图，自由探索
探索地图上的四大村落，完成村落任务，揭开它们的秘密。深入玄妙秘境，战胜诡奇怪物，发掘宝藏、勇探蝙蝠洞、为百姓惩戒山贼。
与全地图的矿主签订契约，让古人来为你打工。
 
多种玩法，自由选择
做能工巧匠还是交际达人？武林第一人还是生活小能手？都由你自己决定。
打造灵药、武器、衣饰，做古代的手工达人。20余种不同增益的菜肴，在你的厨房里制作吧！

游戏特色

穿越题材 × 模拟经营 × RPG养成，多元融合

us.description:
据说西边有神龙，得之可长生不老，天下无敌！无数豪杰加入了这场寻宝游戏，弱者暴毙，赢家通吃。你会是走的最远的一个吗……
《西行乱斗》是一款看似休闲实则硬核、脑洞极大的卡牌自走棋游戏。培育果树锻造神兵，组合法宝构筑流派，你可以选择不同角色开始他们的冒险故事，也可以参与异步匹配的排位竞技场与其他玩家捉对厮杀。种田养猪能修仙，背包整理可渡劫，超多奇葩套路等你解锁，每一次西行都是全新的策略实验！

种田人打牌魂的究极缝合
游戏创新地将种田元素融入自走棋模式，用种植酿造饮食买卖的逻辑包装玩法。每个阵营都设计了特色的养成机制，或养猪开吃，或种树致富，又或锻造投石、挖矿修真……养成流派与你的“种田”大法密不可分，需要利用有限的物品格规划资源的循环产出，实现收益最大化，烧脑又上头。

背包管理流派构筑超上头
游戏以经典卡牌自走棋为原型，融合了背包管理要素。6大阵营、40+角色、200+道具开启排列组合狂欢！ 3个角色栏位、12个道具格，每次摆放都是场微型战略部署，需要疯狂开动大脑才能探索出技能组合最优解。构筑爱好者狂喜！

画风抽象张力爆炸
对众多家喻户晓的神话和历史人物进行重绘。画风预警，每个角色都被毕加索开了光——非常抽象，但休闲解压，只此一家，并在抽象手绘与功能传达间取得微妙平衡。怎么不是一种特色呢！

中式神魔大乱炖，仙之人兮列如麻
中式世界观打底，乱炖各神话体系下的妖魔鬼怪以及不同年代的历史人物。角色技能与其背景出处挂钩，并在游戏内被重新整编进了饿鬼寨、金元会、天地通、八仙班、流兵营、炼气宗这六大阵营。阎罗孟婆、朱雀饕餮、吕布貂蝉再就业；孔明碗、致富经、芭蕉扇显神通。故事模式中还有7段无厘头风格的角色漫画等你探索。

Wall of Insanity is a new project from the creators of the Slaughter game series.
It features a dark storyline, intense action, and a mystical journey into a dead, smoldering world.
You will face the unknown. A descent into a kingdom of anxiety and madness. The path through the abyss will be difficult, the trek extremely dangerous, and you will be left almost hopeless.


Story:

A police operation to detain a dangerous cult's sectarians leads to unexpectedly deadly consequences. That squad vanished under mysterious circumstances, and the Special Unit soldiers sent in to investigate their disappearance find just an empty, abandoned house. This is only where the story begins...



Key Features:

- Active battles with the use of firearms. Survival depends on caution, reaction speed, and weapon accuracy. Use elements of the environment itself to escape this horrific world.

- A journey to another world where fear, sorrow, and madness rule. A diligently crafted, ominous environment, fraught with mystery and danger, lies ahead of you. How far will you dare to go?

- A plethora of traps and enemies await around every corner. Investigate your surroundings carefully. Don't take unnecessary risks. Study your enemies. Carefully selected tactics will save your ammunition.  And your life.

- Explore the world to replenish and expand your arsenal. Weapons and useful items will be needed.  Look for secrets, documents, and workarounds to prevail against all odds.

- Wall of Insanity features simple controls, gamepad support, good optimization, and a wide graphics customization.

us.description:
Atomic Space Age was a blast! Until it became the Post-Apocalyptic Space Age.

Your space station is about to explode and you only have 60 seconds before things get messy. What (or who) will you grab before you make a mad dash for the emergency shuttle and begin your journey into THE GREAT UNKNOWN?

This is 60 Parsecs!, a dark comedy sci-fi adventure set in the Atomic Space Age - complete with all the Cold War paranoia, chrome-plated wall accents and cockroaches with space helmets.

Lead a crew of woefully unprepared astronauts, equipped with whatever junk - sorry - "supplies" you can grab before blasting off, on a journey across the cosmos that's best described as misguided. Make the best of it, while dealing with soup shortages and other horrors of outer space. Will you have what it takes to find a new home and survive?

Bon voyage!


SCAVENGE & EVACUATE
With only 60 seconds before nukes reduce the space station to floating particles in the vacuum of space, frantically grab whatever supplies and crew you can before getting out of there. You never know when that sock puppet will come in handy.

SURVIVE & DECIDE
Space funerals are inconvenient, so try to avoid dying where possible. Use your limited supplies and (hopefully not limited) wits to make difficult choices and ensure your survival, even though the odds are definitely stacked against you.

EXPLORE & CRAFT
Duct tape fixes all problems, but how do you fix (or at least craft) duct tape? Chart expeditions to find resources, craft survival essentials and explore strange new worlds in a procedural, very-much-permadeath adventure.

LEAD & PROTECT
As captain, it's your duty to keep the crew happy - they're less likely to kill you that way. Manage relationships as you watch them grow closer and hopefully not throw each other out the airlock.

Dolores, Ted, Mary Jane and Timmy return to face the nuclear apocalypse in this new, remastered edition of the classic atomic adventure - 60 Seconds! Reatomized, featuring high resolution art support, refreshed 2D graphics and hand-drawn 3D textures, new interactive menu, improved UI system, a technical refresh, and of course... new content!

NEW GAMEPLAY MODE
Survival Challenges - unique, short storylines which will put your survival skills to the test!

NEW OPPORTUNITIES
to escape the wasteland in form of a storyline spanning across multiple playthroughs! Can you escape the wasteland in style?

NEW RELATIONSHIP SYSTEM
more stories and crazy interactions between the McDoodle family members!

NEW SOUNDS, ART AND UNLOCKABLE VISUAL CONTENT
allowing you to add a little color to your fallout shelter!

NEW ACHIEVEMENTS!

Ration food and water, make best use of your supplies, face difficult choices and even venture into the wasteland.

Good luck.

Juicy Realm is a roguelike game with fruits as enemies. It is set in a world in which the line between animals and plants is blurred. It began with the tipping of the food-chain, which forced the humans to establish an outpost and begin an investigation in the region where the first species of mutated plants was discovered. The military has prepared a vast number of powerful weapons, with you leading the vanguard forces to wage this long war.

Subverted Order
“Many years later, when the humans watch as the plants climb up to the top of the food chain, they will be reminded of their own naivety and arrogance…”
Only when all the plants started to evolve into animals, growing limbs and becoming sentient, did the humans realize the threat of those photosynthetic-lifeforms. No one knows how they achieved the state of evolution that took animal lifeforms millions of years to reach in such a short amount of time, and no one knows their ultimate objective. The only thing known for sure is that the humans now face the greatest challenge since they climbed up to the top of the food chain.

As the first explorers of this unknown region, you must strive to venture deep into the enemy hive, defeat all kinds of fruits and arm yourself with various equipment, as well as upgrade yourself with the resources you find in your way.

us.description:
Mobile Wake on LAN (WOL) app is a useful tool for remote system administrators who want to wake up computers from a distance. It is an application that uses the network interface card of the computer to send a magic packet to the target device to wake it up from sleep mode or hibernation. WOL application can be downloaded and installed on mobile devices such as smartphones or tablets, which enables the user to control the target device remotely.

KEY FEATURES:

- Easy to use interface: WOL application has a simple and user-friendly interface that makes it easy to use for both novice and expert users.
- Multiple device support: The application can send a magic packet to multiple devices at once, which makes it more efficient when managing large networks.
- IPv6 support: WOL application allows the user to set IPv6 address when they want to wake up their devices.
- Multiple device launch: The user can also remotely turn on one, two or more devices at the same time.

The WOL app is an excellent tool for remote management, providing users with an easy-to-use interface, and multiple device support. It is a must-have for any remote system administrator who wants to save time and increase productivity while managing their network from a distance.

us.description:
AudioTools from Studio Six Digital is a suite of professional-grade audio and acoustic analysis apps. Included in the price of this app is a great collection of professional tools -- SPL, RTA, FFT, Speaker Polarity Test, Generator, Audio Scope, CLF Viewer, and Recorder, and the framework to add more powerful modules as you need them.

Customize AudioTools for your needs by buying any of the additional optional modules, like Smaart Tools I, SPL Graph, or Impulse Response, at any time right from your iOS device.

We test every iOS device and calibrate the microphone level and frequency response for the best results. We have the ability to turn off the Apple low frequency filters, and on many devices we can measure up to 120 dB SPL.

Add iTestMic, iPrecisionMic, or iAudioInterface2 for a complete professional audio and acoustic test and measurement platform.

Actual reviews:

“...AudioTools is a “how did I ever live without it” app”.

“I think this application is the best I EVER purchased.”

“I have used many thousands of dollars of complicated test equipment that doesn’t measure up to this app suite.”

***** Included in the app price *****

* SPL Meter
A faithful reproduction of a classic analog SPL meter. Includes A and C weighting, and Fast and Slow ANSI decay modes. All filters meet or exceed ANSI type 1.

* RTA
A 1/3 and octave band Real Time Analyzer. Includes touch-GUI range control, a cursor, max/min bars, and noise curve overlays. 

* FFT
Detailed acoustic analysis, up to 32876 points. View full detail or smooth to 1/24, 1/6, 1/3 or octave. Includes cursor, scalable graphics, and peak tracking.

* Polarity
Speaker polarity checker. Route the test signal to a speaker, and read the polarity of the speaker on the screen.

* CLF Viewer
Show loudspeaker data, including plots for impedance, axial response, sensitivity, polar response, and 6dB coverage, and a 3D color balloon plot. 

* Delay Finder
Measures the time it takes for a pulse to return from a speaker. 

* Generator
Generates sine waves, square waves, white and pink noise.

* Line Level Tests
A line level measurement function and frequency counter.

* Audio Scope
A dual-channel audio oscilloscope that includes auto-triggering, variable gain and sweep rate, and storage of scope images.

* Recorder
A mono/stereo audio recorder with WAV and compressed formats and 8k-48k sample rate. Transfer files via WIFI.

* File transfer of results via wifi to PC / Mac.

***** Optional modules available for purchase from within AudioTools *****

* SoundScope VR - FFT-based audio analyzer with VR.
The powerful acoustical analysis module. Includes RTA graphs to 1/48th octave and Spectrograph, and can display VR.

* Transfer Function -- Requires 2-channel interface. 
Two-channel FFT-based measurement. Allows you to analyze sound system performance with music or pink noise as the signal source.

* ETC
Energy Time Curve. Plot decay of an impulse over time, and compute RT60 time. Internal or External trigger.

* Impulse Response
Record and analyze an impulse or sine sweep, compute octave and 1/3 octave ETC, T30, C50, C80, CT, Definition.

Plot second-by-second SPL level for up to 24 hours, and optionally record the audio. Also, add the optional Octave Band Logging upgrade to elevate this tool to rival any professional logging SPL Meter.

us.description:
Onyx is a revolutionary utility that allows you to modify a captured image in real-time using variable input data.

Using cutting edge AI, Onyx lets you remotely create seamless alterations to photos moments after they've been taken - all with your spectator's camera.

For example:
— Make a playing card appear in your spectator's wallet.
— Morph your spectator's shadow to look like their thought of animal.
— Take a photo of your spectator holding a signed card. They name *any* other card. The signed card in the photo transforms to match their thought.
— Supplement your Gypsy Queen routine with Onyx: zoom in on a photo of your spectator holding the Queen of Hearts for the reveal.
— Reveal a thought-of word, name, or initials hidden naturally in the light reflections of a spectator's eye.
— Change the time on a photo of a clock.
— Remove your spectator's wristwatch in a photo, making it sbeem that it was removed earlier.

...and more! If you can describe it, Onyx can likely create it.

Onyx is particularly great for revealing something ephemeral. Photograph a shadow, clouds, a TV screen or more, and Onyx will realistically insert their free choice.

* Variable Delayed Input
Inspired by the popular variable trigger system featured in DFB X, Onyx pauses and automatically waits for input, letting you remotely modify a photo *after* it's been taken.

* Cutting Edge Technology
Take a photo, then have your spectator make a free choice. Onyx's advanced technology seamlessly transforms the photo remotely.

* Create Unlimited Effects
Change signed playing cards, reveal initials and names, or modify writing. Reveal *anything you can imagine* within a genuine photo you just took.

* Your Integrations. Their Camera
The effect happens entirely with the spectator's camera. With Onyx's powerful integrations, your phone never needs to leave your pocket.

* Invisible, Advanced Technology
As only the spectator's device is in play, Onyx remains hidden and inconspicuous.

* Third Party Integrations
Use your favourite magic apps' input methods, including:
— Earworm's covert typing Web Search & Notes input
— Native voice input
— Native clock swipe input
— WebFX's Wrist Gestures
— WikiTest
— PeekSmith
— Bridge

...and any compatible third-party app.

# Introducing: Onyx Print
Onyx Print brings Onyx’s digital effect into the real world.

# Produce Physical Photographs
Instead of revealing information only on a screen, Onyx Print can generate and automatically print images on a pocket printer, allowing you to produce a real photograph from your wallet, pocket, or envelope for a powerful ending.

# Dynamic Prompting
Onyx Print uses the same dynamic prompting and covert input system that powers Onyx.
Use any of Onyx’s input methods, and Onyx Print will automatically generate and print an image to match.

# Use Your Own Photos
You can even modify existing photos. For example: have Onyx Print set up with a photo of yourself and have a spectator name any place in the world. Onyx Print will then create and automatically print a realistic photo of you in that exact location, ready to reveal.

# Works With Other Apps
Onyx Print can even monitor your photo library and automatically print images saved by other apps. When an app saves a photo, Onyx Print can print it.

Onyx Print is an in-app purchase within Onyx, and currently supports the Instax mini Link+, with plans for additional printers in the future.

Onyx is a tool specifically designed for entertainment purposes. It uses purchaseable in-app credits or a funded OpenRouter account for best-in-class automatic edits.

Onyx supports: Arabic, Bengali, Bulgarian, Chinese simplified and traditional, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Latvian, Lithuanian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese

us.description:
Pixel Miner is a pixel digging adventure with no ads, no in-app purchases and no timers, and it can be played fully offline.

Why is Kit so eager to keep on digging, bringing back more ore each time, upgrading the digger to get more minerals and building a railway to…where exactly?

With one finger help Kit find amazing minerals and hidden treasures deep underground. Accept contracts and their rewards. Each new mine is deeper, with stranger stones.

When you come back to the surface you can:

• upgrade your digger with faster bits, bigger fuel tanks and brighter lamps
• grow your station from a plank hut into a busy railway stop
• improve each mine so every trip down goes further
• run trains that bring extra ore

But you’ll start to notice some things are not as they should be: an abandoned mine full of old tools and records, a town across the gorge whose lamps have gone out, and something waiting at the very bottom.

Features:

• one-finger controls
• short runs that fit into a few spare minutes
• beautiful pixel art
• a railway you build stretch by stretch
• contracts on every run, from buyers who pay more as they get to know you
• a weekly challenge mine with its own leaderboard
• fossils, relics and rare finds to collect and put on show at the train station
• paint, decals and horns for your digger
• Game Center achievements and leaderboards
• iCloud save compatibility

Pick it up for a few minutes or a whole evening, and see how deep the valley goes…and who’s waiting for you at the end.

us.description:
Every enchantment is a gamble. Some of them make you stronger. Others, change the world completely.

Enchanted Survival is a survival roguelite. The weapons fire themselves, so the only thing you control is where you stand, and what you enchant and upgrade. Between waves the fighting stops and you walk to a lit shrine, feed it the crystals you picked up off the dead, and ask for an enchantment without being told what is coming.

Most enchantments improve an item. Then a pair of boots comes back with Frozenfoot, the lake you have been fighting beside freezes solid under your feet, and the half of the map you could never reach is the half you fight on for the rest of the run. 

Over 650 enchantments across lots of equipment. Pay for a deeper ritual and the rare results get likelier, and now and then two arrive at once. A clue tells you what the rite is leaning toward. 

KEEP WHAT YOU ROLLED, OR PUSH IT
Strengthen an enchantment through three tiers. Wager crystals at the anvil to temper a piece and raise its own number, then watch the bar run without knowing where it stops. Strip an enchantment out and free the socket. All of it is paid in the same crystals you could have spent on a fresh roll instead.

TEN LEVELS THAT EACH FIGHT BACK
A meadow built around a lake. A desert of pyramids and one oasis. Glacier basin, volcanic field, mushroom marsh, storm plateau, lighthouse coast, sunken ruins, crystal cavern. Some of them fall dark, and light turns into something you carry, place and stand near. 

THREE HEROES WHO PLAY DIFFERENTLY
The Adventurer, who starts the way the game was written. The Fisher, who swims open water instead of drowning in it and gets chased faster for the privilege. The Ranger, who opens with the bow and turns every ritual up a level.

CARRY ONE THING FORWARD
Clear a level and one worn item comes with you into every run after it. Finish a run and it pays out shards, which the stall at the head of the road turns into a second weapon, a better starting item, or a first ritual rolled a level deeper than you paid for.

FEATURES
- Over 650 enchantments, every one of them doing something you can see
- Enchant, strengthen, temper and strip, all on one currency
- Elites, minibosses and bosses that hold the wave until they fall
- Dark levels where light is something you have to bring
- A Codex and a bestiary that fill in as you go
- One thumb, landscape, built for a phone
- Eight languages
- Paid once. No ads, no in-app purchases, fully offline

us.releaseNotes: Digline keeps expanding! There are rumors that past your neighbor's house to the left, a new mysterious character has arrived. And he brings tons of experiments for you to try on your digger. At least some of them should work...maybe.
us.description:
Digline is a relaxed and easy to learn drilling game where every descent is a gamble between progress and risk, and the real reward lies deeper underground.

Start each run in your workshop, pick your setup, and head down with limited fuel and a scrappy rig. Carve your path through shifting layers of earth, decide what to collect, and choose what to upgrade and what to trade before everything runs out.

Each dive reveals new materials, rarer finds, and unexpected patterns beneath the surface. What begins as simple digging gradually turns into a careful balance between exploration, efficiency, and timing.

Back at the surface, refine your strategy and improve your runs:

• Upgrade your drill, fuel capacity, and efficiency
• Unlock new materials with higher value and deeper placement
• Optimize routes to maximize each descent

Progress builds steadily, but every run carries tension. Go too safe and you leave value behind. Push too far and risk losing it all.

Shape your own rhythm underground: short and efficient runs, deep high-risk dives, or a steady climb toward mastering what lies below.

Top 10 casual game in the US and UK, Top 5 in Germany, Norway, and others. Come join the fun!

What starts as a simple search for resources gradually becomes something stranger. Your old tunnels remain, your map expands over time, and the underground begins to feel less random and more like a place with its own history.

Digline is designed to be easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, and rewarding over the long term. Quick digs, short descents, tons of relaxing fun.

• short runs that fit easily into a minute or two
• persistent tunnels and a map that grows with each expedition
• multiple underground regions with different materials, hazards, and surprises

us.description:
Titan Quest has captivated legions of players since its 2006 debut. You get the all-encompassing experience of an unbridled, truly heroic journey through the worlds of Titan Quest!

Your honorable quest is to save the world!

The gods alone cannot defeat the Titans, so real heroes are needed - and that can only be you! Your success or failure will decide the fate of the people and the Olympians! With your custom-created hero, scour the mystical and ancient worlds of Greece, Egypt, Babylon, and China. Conquer the hordes of legendary creatures and master various weapons and martial arts: Archery, sword fighting, or the use of powerful magic!

Travel a world of antiquity and Nordic mythology!

Battle the beasts of mythology as you travel to the Parthenon, the Great Pyramids, the Hanging Gardens of Babylon, the Great Wall, the Tartarus Arena, and other famous places. Encounter the greatest villains of Greek mythology, discover the uncharted lands of northern Europe, search for the mythical kingdom of Atlantis, and set out on a journey across the western Mediterranean.

It’s all or nothing on your glorious path!

With each challenge that awaits you, you'll have to defeat bigger and stronger enemies until you reach your goal and force the Titans to their knees! Rush into battle alongside brave pet companions! Find extraordinary items with special powers that will enhance your abilities and help you on your path. Legendary swords, powerful lightning spells, magical, bows and numerous other treasures with unimaginable powers await you - all of them are at your disposal in your battles and spread fear and terror among the hideous creatures!

What are you waiting for?

Like no other game in the Action RPG genre, Titan Quest: Legendary Edition combines the fascinating world of mythology with endless and exciting action that you would expect from such a compelling game!

Features:
+ Within the world of the Immortal Throne DLC, you’ll encounter the greatest villains of Greek mythology, brave the attacks of Cerberus, and hazard the banks of the River Styx. You have to interpret the prophecies of the blind seer Tiresias, fight alongside Agamemnon and Achilles, and use the wiles of Odysseus to conquer this dark new adventure.

+ In the uncharted lands of northern Europe in the Ragnarök DLC, you’ll brave the realms of the Celts, the Northmen, and the Asgardian gods!

+ Meet an explorer in the Atlantis DLC, in search of the mythical kingdom of Atlantis. A key is supposedly hidden in the diary of Herakles, which is rumored to be located in the Phoenician City of Gadir. Set out on a journey across the western Mediterranean, including the Tartarus Arena for epic battles!

+ All important updates have been implemented to the technically overhauled Titan Quest to grant the best gaming experience of this classic ever!

+ ETERNAL EMBERS DLCs available as in-app purchase - Summoned by the legendary Emperor Yao, the Hero is called back into the East to deal with a demonic threat that has been ravaging the land after the Telkine was slain.

! A note for all players who own the base version of Titan Quest: The DLCs mentioned here are also available for purchase as additional content so that all fans can upgrade their game to fully enjoy all expansions!

Dive into a deep story of corruption, crime and intrigue. Take the role of gritty Police Chief Jack Boyd, and come face to face with the ugly underbelly of Freeburg, a city spiraling the drain. Will Jack reach his retirement with a nice stack of bills, or will he end up broken ... or worse? 

Manage your staff, respond to emergencies, and investigate crimes in a city on the brink of chaos. The mafia underworld maneuvers behind the scenes, sinking their claws ever deeper into the city, even as the mayor is ready to exploit every situation to his political advantage. 

Choose your approach to each situation as it unfolds. Sometimes you’ll be responding to a developing crisis at a crime scene, or negotiating with Freeburg’s crime bosses. Sometimes you’ll find yourself dodging questions in the press room, or even the occasional cross-examination in the witness box. Can you keep this pressure cooker from exploding, at least for long enough to stash away a nice retirement nest egg?

- Decisions, decisions! This Is the Police is all about a dark story and how you react to it. Whatever you decide, your choices will influence the game – and the fate of Jack Boyd.

- The Good, the Bad, and... the Ugly? The Chief of Freeburg's Police Department deals with all kind of people. It is up to you to find the bad guys and decide how to deal with them.

- Carry out your duties. As head of Freeburg PD, Jack deals with all sorts of challenges every day: responding to emergencies, managing his officers, defending the department against City Hall and a corrupt mayor, and much more.

- Solve Investigations and gather evidence against the criminal gangs of Freeburg.

- Deal with the competing powers of the city. Everyone offers you favors, and each one comes at a price.

tr.description:
"Nothing is created, nothing is lost, everything is transformed." - Antoine Lavoisier, 'Elements of Chemistry'

The first 5 stages are free to play, and you can access all stages via an in-app purchase. Existing paid users retain full access to all content at no additional cost..

'Alcyone' is a chemistry puzzle game set across the periodic table. Your goal is to weave scattered elements together to synthesize molecules, and assemble them to trigger chemical reactions. Molecules don't simply stay in place. As temperatures rise and fall, matter changes states between gas, liquid, and solid—floating up or sinking down. This unique system adds depth to the puzzle in a truly distinctive way. Design your own chain reactions and lose track of time in the world of chemistry. Simply enjoy the game, and real-world chemical knowledge will follow like a gift.

Build molecules and trigger reactions.

• Combine elements to synthesize a wide variety of molecules. Experience the vast world of chemistry and find joy in discovering over 1,300 real-world compounds.
• Compounds change through three phases—solid, liquid, and gas—depending on the ambient temperature. Their physical properties, where solids and liquids sink and gases rise, act as key variables in your puzzles.
• Place identical compounds in adjacent cells to trigger reactions. The more complex the elemental composition of the compound, the higher the score you earn, allowing you to find your own efficient scoring path.
• Your score increases exponentially as the number of reacting compounds grows and the chain reactions last longer. Strategize your placement to achieve the highest possible scores.
• From basic reactions like acid-base neutralization and hydrolysis to advanced organic chemistry, combine real-world chemical reactions to design and enjoy spectacular chain reactions.

Explore the periodic table and collect elements.

• Conquering numerous stages organized by atomic number, from Hydrogen (H, 1) to Krypton (Kr, 36), allows you to explore chemistry from basic to advanced levels step-by-step.
• Every time you complete a stage, you can collect new elements or unlock new chemical reactions that expand the possibilities of your experiments and your scientific toolkit.
• Upgrade each element to significantly boost your scoring efficiency. As you upgrade specific elements, the value of every compound containing them increases, letting you reach much higher scores.
• Acquire and upgrade organic functional groups to improve synthesis efficiency. Even compounds with complex structures can be created much more easily and quickly using upgraded functional groups.

Alcyone is continuously improved through regular updates. Focus entirely on the joy of chemistry, with no pop-up ads.

tr.description:
Lead Japan's merchant fleet to import resources and export goods!
Engage in trade, power up domestic industries, and drive the rapid growth of the Japanese economy!

Japan relies on imports for many of its essential resources, with 99% of these shipments transported by merchant vessels such as tankers and bulk carriers.
Imported resources are processed domestically into various goods for export, generating foreign currency. Merchant ships—including container ships and car carriers—play a vital role in these exports as well.

Building a merchant ship can take two to three years or more; consequently, many shipping companies secure the vessels they operate by leasing them from shipowners (a practice known as "chartering").


Use your merchant fleet to handle imports and exports, activate key domestic industries, and fuel the growth of the Japanese economy!
There are just two main tasks for the player:

1.
Charter merchant ships! You can sign contracts by selecting the charter period, ship type, and vessel size. Once chartered, simply choose your trading partners and the goods to be traded, and the ships will set sail.

2.
Operate essential domestic industries! By supplying valuable resources to these industries, you can manufacture products. These goods can be consumed domestically or sold as exports to earn foreign currency. Infrastructure that generates energy cannot be allowed to stop; oil, LNG (liquefied natural gas), and coal are vital to the Japanese economy. Make sure to keep imports flowing!


It’s "Game Over" if you run out of any of the essentials for infrastructure and daily life: oil, LNG, coal, food, or money. Keep a close eye on your resource stockpiles as you manage the Japanese economy!


There are absolutely no advertisements or in-app purchases—feel free to focus entirely on the gameplay.

All you have to do is adjust the number of train cars and make the trains depart at the best time.
As the game progresses, express fares will also appear.

No technical knowledge is required at all.
Both people who like trains and people who like games can quickly understand and enjoy the game.

tr.description:
Groundwire: the SIP softphone for your PBX or VoIP provider

Groundwire is a SIP softphone app from Acrobits, a leader in VoIP and communication software since 2009. It delivers clear voice and video calls for personal and professional use, with an interface built for daily calling and none of the clutter.

IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ

Groundwire is a SIP client, not a VoIP service. You need service from a VoIP provider or PBX that supports standard SIP clients.

Business calling features

Groundwire carries the call handling you expect from a desk phone:

- Group calls, for conferencing several people into one conversation.
- Attended transfers, so you can announce a caller before handing the call over.
- Unattended transfers, when the caller just needs the right extension.
- Voicemail with notifications, so a missed call still reaches you.
- Instant messaging, for the things that do not need a call.
- Per-account settings, so one device carries several SIP identities cleanly.

Works with your PBX or VoIP provider

Groundwire is a universal client and true VoIP for PBX users. Teams run it as an Asterisk softphone, a FreePBX extension, or a 3CX endpoint, and it connects just as readily to hosted PBX systems and business phone providers. It also comes preconfigured for major providers, so setup takes minutes. Because it is a standard client, there is no lock-in: bring the account you already have, and Groundwire becomes the mobile extension of your PBX, with encrypted SIP calling on every network.

On a team it is the business softphone dialer sitting on top of the PBX you already pay for. On your own it keeps a work line separate, or carries a desk extension in your pocket.

Key features of the softphone

- Audio on widely used codecs, Opus, G.729 and G.711 among them.
- Video calls at 720p HD, carried by H.264 and VP8.
- Private conversations with military-grade encryption, including TLS, SRTP, and ZRTP.
- Low battery use thanks to efficient push notifications.
- The VoIP dialer hands calls over between WiFi and mobile data without dropping them.
- Custom call settings, UI, and ringtones per account.
- 5G ready and compatible with most mobile operating systems.

A softphone app without the fees

Groundwire is a softphone for calling over WiFi and mobile data, with the business dialer features that usually cost a monthly fee. One payment, no subscription, nothing hidden: buy it once and it stays yours. Encryption sits inside that price rather than on top of it.

Run a call center, manage a fleet of extensions, or keep a dependable sip phone for a home office. The same app covers all of it, without extra tiers.

Download Groundwire and put a dependable SIP dialer on your phone, with Acrobits engineering and responsive support behind it.

tr.description:
Mobile Wake on LAN (WOL) app is a useful tool for remote system administrators who want to wake up computers from a distance. It is an application that uses the network interface card of the computer to send a magic packet to the target device to wake it up from sleep mode or hibernation. WOL application can be downloaded and installed on mobile devices such as smartphones or tablets, which enables the user to control the target device remotely.

KEY FEATURES:

- Easy to use interface: WOL application has a simple and user-friendly interface that makes it easy to use for both novice and expert users.
- Multiple device support: The application can send a magic packet to multiple devices at once, which makes it more efficient when managing large networks.
- IPv6 support: WOL application allows the user to set IPv6 address when they want to wake up their devices.
- Multiple device launch: The user can also remotely turn on one, two or more devices at the same time.

The WOL app is an excellent tool for remote management, providing users with an easy-to-use interface, and multiple device support. It is a must-have for any remote system administrator who wants to save time and increase productivity while managing their network from a distance.

This is only where the story begins...

tr.description:
Atomic Space Age was a blast! Until it became the Post-Apocalyptic Space Age.

Your space station is about to explode and you only have 60 seconds before things get messy. What (or who) will you grab before you make a mad dash for the emergency shuttle and begin your journey into THE GREAT UNKNOWN?

This is 60 Parsecs!, a dark comedy sci-fi adventure set in the Atomic Space Age - complete with all the Cold War paranoia, chrome-plated wall accents and cockroaches with space helmets.

Lead a crew of woefully unprepared astronauts, equipped with whatever junk - sorry - "supplies" you can grab before blasting off, on a journey across the cosmos that's best described as misguided. Make the best of it, while dealing with soup shortages and other horrors of outer space. Will you have what it takes to find a new home and survive?

Bon voyage!


SCAVENGE & EVACUATE
With only 60 seconds before nukes reduce the space station to floating particles in the vacuum of space, frantically grab whatever supplies and crew you can before getting out of there. You never know when that sock puppet will come in handy.

SURVIVE & DECIDE
Space funerals are inconvenient, so try to avoid dying where possible. Use your limited supplies and (hopefully not limited) wits to make difficult choices and ensure your survival, even though the odds are definitely stacked against you.

EXPLORE & CRAFT
Duct tape fixes all problems, but how do you fix (or at least craft) duct tape? Chart expeditions to find resources, craft survival essentials and explore strange new worlds in a procedural, very-much-permadeath adventure.

LEAD & PROTECT
As captain, it's your duty to keep the crew happy - they're less likely to kill you that way. Manage relationships as you watch them grow closer and hopefully not throw each other out the airlock.

tr.description:
Onyx is a revolutionary utility that allows you to modify a captured image in real-time using variable input data.

Using cutting edge AI, Onyx lets you remotely create seamless alterations to photos moments after they've been taken - all with your spectator's camera.

For example:
— Make a playing card appear in your spectator's wallet.
— Morph your spectator's shadow to look like their thought of animal.
— Take a photo of your spectator holding a signed card. They name *any* other card. The signed card in the photo transforms to match their thought.
— Supplement your Gypsy Queen routine with Onyx: zoom in on a photo of your spectator holding the Queen of Hearts for the reveal.
— Reveal a thought-of word, name, or initials hidden naturally in the light reflections of a spectator's eye.
— Change the time on a photo of a clock.
— Remove your spectator's wristwatch in a photo, making it sbeem that it was removed earlier.

...and more! If you can describe it, Onyx can likely create it.

Onyx is particularly great for revealing something ephemeral. Photograph a shadow, clouds, a TV screen or more, and Onyx will realistically insert their free choice.

* Variable Delayed Input
Inspired by the popular variable trigger system featured in DFB X, Onyx pauses and automatically waits for input, letting you remotely modify a photo *after* it's been taken.

* Cutting Edge Technology
Take a photo, then have your spectator make a free choice. Onyx's advanced technology seamlessly transforms the photo remotely.

* Create Unlimited Effects
Change signed playing cards, reveal initials and names, or modify writing. Reveal *anything you can imagine* within a genuine photo you just took.

* Your Integrations. Their Camera
The effect happens entirely with the spectator's camera. With Onyx's powerful integrations, your phone never needs to leave your pocket.

* Invisible, Advanced Technology
As only the spectator's device is in play, Onyx remains hidden and inconspicuous.

* Third Party Integrations
Use your favourite magic apps' input methods, including:
— Earworm's covert typing Web Search & Notes input
— Native voice input
— Native clock swipe input
— WebFX's Wrist Gestures
— WikiTest
— PeekSmith
— Bridge

...and any compatible third-party app.

# Introducing: Onyx Print
Onyx Print brings Onyx’s digital effect into the real world.

# Produce Physical Photographs
Instead of revealing information only on a screen, Onyx Print can generate and automatically print images on a pocket printer, allowing you to produce a real photograph from your wallet, pocket, or envelope for a powerful ending.

# Dynamic Prompting
Onyx Print uses the same dynamic prompting and covert input system that powers Onyx.
Use any of Onyx’s input methods, and Onyx Print will automatically generate and print an image to match.

# Use Your Own Photos
You can even modify existing photos. For example: have Onyx Print set up with a photo of yourself and have a spectator name any place in the world. Onyx Print will then create and automatically print a realistic photo of you in that exact location, ready to reveal.

# Works With Other Apps
Onyx Print can even monitor your photo library and automatically print images saved by other apps. When an app saves a photo, Onyx Print can print it.

Onyx Print is an in-app purchase within Onyx, and currently supports the Instax mini Link+, with plans for additional printers in the future.

Onyx is a tool specifically designed for entertainment purposes. It uses purchaseable in-app credits or a funded OpenRouter account for best-in-class automatic edits.

Onyx supports: Arabic, Bengali, Bulgarian, Chinese simplified and traditional, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Latvian, Lithuanian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese

tr.description:
Pixel Miner is a pixel digging adventure with no ads, no in-app purchases and no timers, and it can be played fully offline.

Why is Kit so eager to keep on digging, bringing back more ore each time, upgrading the digger to get more minerals and building a railway to…where exactly?

With one finger help Kit find amazing minerals and hidden treasures deep underground. Accept contracts and their rewards. Each new mine is deeper, with stranger stones.

When you come back to the surface you can:

• upgrade your digger with faster bits, bigger fuel tanks and brighter lamps
• grow your station from a plank hut into a busy railway stop
• improve each mine so every trip down goes further
• run trains that bring extra ore

But you’ll start to notice some things are not as they should be: an abandoned mine full of old tools and records, a town across the gorge whose lamps have gone out, and something waiting at the very bottom.

Features:

• one-finger controls
• short runs that fit into a few spare minutes
• beautiful pixel art
• a railway you build stretch by stretch
• contracts on every run, from buyers who pay more as they get to know you
• a weekly challenge mine with its own leaderboard
• fossils, relics and rare finds to collect and put on show at the train station
• paint, decals and horns for your digger
• Game Center achievements and leaderboards
• iCloud save compatibility

Pick it up for a few minutes or a whole evening, and see how deep the valley goes…and who’s waiting for you at the end.

tr.description:
Every enchantment is a gamble. Some of them make you stronger. Others, change the world completely.

Enchanted Survival is a survival roguelite. The weapons fire themselves, so the only thing you control is where you stand, and what you enchant and upgrade. Between waves the fighting stops and you walk to a lit shrine, feed it the crystals you picked up off the dead, and ask for an enchantment without being told what is coming.

Most enchantments improve an item. Then a pair of boots comes back with Frozenfoot, the lake you have been fighting beside freezes solid under your feet, and the half of the map you could never reach is the half you fight on for the rest of the run. 

Over 650 enchantments across lots of equipment. Pay for a deeper ritual and the rare results get likelier, and now and then two arrive at once. A clue tells you what the rite is leaning toward. 

KEEP WHAT YOU ROLLED, OR PUSH IT
Strengthen an enchantment through three tiers. Wager crystals at the anvil to temper a piece and raise its own number, then watch the bar run without knowing where it stops. Strip an enchantment out and free the socket. All of it is paid in the same crystals you could have spent on a fresh roll instead.

TEN LEVELS THAT EACH FIGHT BACK
A meadow built around a lake. A desert of pyramids and one oasis. Glacier basin, volcanic field, mushroom marsh, storm plateau, lighthouse coast, sunken ruins, crystal cavern. Some of them fall dark, and light turns into something you carry, place and stand near. 

THREE HEROES WHO PLAY DIFFERENTLY
The Adventurer, who starts the way the game was written. The Fisher, who swims open water instead of drowning in it and gets chased faster for the privilege. The Ranger, who opens with the bow and turns every ritual up a level.

CARRY ONE THING FORWARD
Clear a level and one worn item comes with you into every run after it. Finish a run and it pays out shards, which the stall at the head of the road turns into a second weapon, a better starting item, or a first ritual rolled a level deeper than you paid for.

FEATURES
- Over 650 enchantments, every one of them doing something you can see
- Enchant, strengthen, temper and strip, all on one currency
- Elites, minibosses and bosses that hold the wave until they fall
- Dark levels where light is something you have to bring
- A Codex and a bestiary that fill in as you go
- One thumb, landscape, built for a phone
- Eight languages
- Paid once. No ads, no in-app purchases, fully offline

tr.description:
The neighborhood is waiting. The seal of office is now yours.

Neighborhood Head is an election-driven local management simulator where every decision affects your residents and your time in office. New requests arrive at your door each day. Listen, investigate the case, and choose how to respond.

Approve a request, reject it, mediate between neighbors, or refer the matter to the municipality. The right answer is rarely obvious. A choice that helps one resident may strain the treasury, while a problem you postpone today may return days later.

Your work extends beyond the files on your desk. Balance the treasury, approval rating, and reputation while shaping your relationships with recurring residents. Earlier choices return through connected events, and their consequences may be felt for days.

Use your resources to improve the streets with parks, lighting, a market, a health clinic, and more. These permanent upgrades transform the neighborhood and open new possibilities for your management strategy.

Grow support during the campaign, complete your term goals, and win another term at the ballot box. You can meet only a limited number of residents each day. Can you earn the neighborhood's trust without emptying its treasury?

Play in English or Turkish. The door is open; your next resident is waiting.

Neighborhood Head is a fictional management simulation created solely for entertainment. Its characters and events do not represent real people, institutions, or political parties.

tr.description:
Digline is a relaxed and easy to learn drilling game where every descent is a gamble between progress and risk, and the real reward lies deeper underground.

Start each run in your workshop, pick your setup, and head down with limited fuel and a scrappy rig. Carve your path through shifting layers of earth, decide what to collect, and choose what to upgrade and what to trade before everything runs out.

Each dive reveals new materials, rarer finds, and unexpected patterns beneath the surface. What begins as simple digging gradually turns into a careful balance between exploration, efficiency, and timing.

Back at the surface, refine your strategy and improve your runs:

• Upgrade your drill, fuel capacity, and efficiency
• Unlock new materials with higher value and deeper placement
• Optimise routes to maximise each descent

Progress builds steadily, but every run carries tension. Go too safe and you leave value behind. Push too far and risk losing it all.

Shape your own rhythm underground: short and efficient runs, deep high-risk dives, or a steady climb towards mastering what lies below.

Top 10 casual game in the UK and US, Top 5 in Germany, Norway, and others. Come join the fun!

What starts as a simple search for resources gradually becomes something stranger. Your old tunnels remain, your map expands over time, and the underground begins to feel less random and more like a place with its own history.

Digline is designed to be easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, and rewarding over the long term. Quick digs, short descents, tons of relaxing fun.

Features:

• intuitive one-finger portrait controls
• short runs that fit easily into a minute or two
• persistent tunnels and a map that grows with each expedition
• multiple underground regions with different materials, hazards, and surprises
• resources to gather and use for crafting upgrades, and better preparation
• a workshop that turns each successful run into permanent progress
• a market system for trading what you bring back
• progression that builds across many sessions, not just a single run
• a calm, cosy atmosphere with a sense of discovery underneath it
• no ads, no in-app purchases, and no pay-to-win systems

The deeper you go, the more the mine will reveal.

pt.description:
"Nothing is created, nothing is lost, everything is transformed." - Antoine Lavoisier, 'Elements of Chemistry'

The first 5 stages are free to play, and you can access all stages via an in-app purchase. Existing paid users retain full access to all content at no additional cost..

'Alcyone' is a chemistry puzzle game set across the periodic table. Your goal is to weave scattered elements together to synthesize molecules, and assemble them to trigger chemical reactions. Molecules don't simply stay in place. As temperatures rise and fall, matter changes states between gas, liquid, and solid—floating up or sinking down. This unique system adds depth to the puzzle in a truly distinctive way. Design your own chain reactions and lose track of time in the world of chemistry. Simply enjoy the game, and real-world chemical knowledge will follow like a gift.

Build molecules and trigger reactions.

• Combine elements to synthesize a wide variety of molecules. Experience the vast world of chemistry and find joy in discovering over 1,300 real-world compounds.
• Compounds change through three phases—solid, liquid, and gas—depending on the ambient temperature. Their physical properties, where solids and liquids sink and gases rise, act as key variables in your puzzles.
• Place identical compounds in adjacent cells to trigger reactions. The more complex the elemental composition of the compound, the higher the score you earn, allowing you to find your own efficient scoring path.
• Your score increases exponentially as the number of reacting compounds grows and the chain reactions last longer. Strategize your placement to achieve the highest possible scores.
• From basic reactions like acid-base neutralization and hydrolysis to advanced organic chemistry, combine real-world chemical reactions to design and enjoy spectacular chain reactions.

Explore the periodic table and collect elements.

• Conquering numerous stages organized by atomic number, from Hydrogen (H, 1) to Krypton (Kr, 36), allows you to explore chemistry from basic to advanced levels step-by-step.
• Every time you complete a stage, you can collect new elements or unlock new chemical reactions that expand the possibilities of your experiments and your scientific toolkit.
• Upgrade each element to significantly boost your scoring efficiency. As you upgrade specific elements, the value of every compound containing them increases, letting you reach much higher scores.
• Acquire and upgrade organic functional groups to improve synthesis efficiency. Even compounds with complex structures can be created much more easily and quickly using upgraded functional groups.

Alcyone is continuously improved through regular updates. Focus entirely on the joy of chemistry, with no pop-up ads.

pt.description:
Lead Japan's merchant fleet to import resources and export goods!
Engage in trade, power up domestic industries, and drive the rapid growth of the Japanese economy!

Japan relies on imports for many of its essential resources, with 99% of these shipments transported by merchant vessels such as tankers and bulk carriers.
Imported resources are processed domestically into various goods for export, generating foreign currency. Merchant ships—including container ships and car carriers—play a vital role in these exports as well.

Building a merchant ship can take two to three years or more; consequently, many shipping companies secure the vessels they operate by leasing them from shipowners (a practice known as "chartering").


Use your merchant fleet to handle imports and exports, activate key domestic industries, and fuel the growth of the Japanese economy!
There are just two main tasks for the player:

1.
Charter merchant ships! You can sign contracts by selecting the charter period, ship type, and vessel size. Once chartered, simply choose your trading partners and the goods to be traded, and the ships will set sail.

2.
Operate essential domestic industries! By supplying valuable resources to these industries, you can manufacture products. These goods can be consumed domestically or sold as exports to earn foreign currency. Infrastructure that generates energy cannot be allowed to stop; oil, LNG (liquefied natural gas), and coal are vital to the Japanese economy. Make sure to keep imports flowing!


It’s "Game Over" if you run out of any of the essentials for infrastructure and daily life: oil, LNG, coal, food, or money. Keep a close eye on your resource stockpiles as you manage the Japanese economy!


There are absolutely no advertisements or in-app purchases—feel free to focus entirely on the gameplay.

pt.description:
Groundwire: the SIP softphone for your PBX or VoIP provider

Groundwire is a SIP softphone app from Acrobits, a leader in VoIP and communication software since 2009. It delivers clear voice and video calls for personal and professional use, with an interface built for daily calling and none of the clutter.

IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ

Groundwire is a SIP client, not a VoIP service. You need service from a VoIP provider or PBX that supports standard SIP clients.

Business calling features

Groundwire carries the call handling you expect from a desk phone:

- Group calls, for conferencing several people into one conversation.
- Attended transfers, so you can announce a caller before handing the call over.
- Unattended transfers, when the caller just needs the right extension.
- Voicemail with notifications, so a missed call still reaches you.
- Instant messaging, for the things that do not need a call.
- Per-account settings, so one device carries several SIP identities cleanly.

Works with your PBX or VoIP provider

Groundwire is a universal client and true VoIP for PBX users. Teams run it as an Asterisk softphone, a FreePBX extension, or a 3CX endpoint, and it connects just as readily to hosted PBX systems and business phone providers. It also comes preconfigured for major providers, so setup takes minutes. Because it is a standard client, there is no lock-in: bring the account you already have, and Groundwire becomes the mobile extension of your PBX, with encrypted SIP calling on every network.

On a team it is the business softphone dialer sitting on top of the PBX you already pay for. On your own it keeps a work line separate, or carries a desk extension in your pocket.

Key features of the softphone

- Audio on widely used codecs, Opus, G.729 and G.711 among them.
- Video calls at 720p HD, carried by H.264 and VP8.
- Private conversations with military-grade encryption, including TLS, SRTP, and ZRTP.
- Low battery use thanks to efficient push notifications.
- The VoIP dialer hands calls over between WiFi and mobile data without dropping them.
- Custom call settings, UI, and ringtones per account.
- 5G ready and compatible with most mobile operating systems.

A softphone app without the fees

Groundwire is a softphone for calling over WiFi and mobile data, with the business dialer features that usually cost a monthly fee. One payment, no subscription, nothing hidden: buy it once and it stays yours. Encryption sits inside that price rather than on top of it.

Run a call center, manage a fleet of extensions, or keep a dependable sip phone for a home office. The same app covers all of it, without extra tiers.

Download Groundwire and put a dependable SIP dialer on your phone, with Acrobits engineering and responsive support behind it.

pt.description:
A aplicação Mobile Wake on LAN (WOL) é uma ferramenta útil para administradores de sistemas remotos que pretendem ligar computadores à distância. É uma aplicação que utiliza a placa de rede do computador para enviar um magic packet ao dispositivo alvo e despertá-lo do modo de suspensão ou hibernação. A aplicação WOL pode ser transferida e instalada em dispositivos móveis, como smartphones ou tablets, permitindo ao utilizador controlar o dispositivo alvo remotamente.

PRINCIPAIS FUNCIONALIDADES:

- Interface fácil de usar: o WOL tem uma interface simples e intuitiva, adequada tanto a utilizadores principiantes como experientes.
- Suporte para múltiplos dispositivos: a aplicação consegue enviar um magic packet para vários dispositivos em simultâneo, o que a torna mais eficiente na gestão de redes grandes.
- Suporte IPv6: o WOL permite ao utilizador definir um endereço IPv6 quando pretende ligar os seus dispositivos.
- Arranque de múltiplos dispositivos: o utilizador pode também ligar remotamente um, dois ou mais dispositivos em simultâneo.

A app WOL é uma excelente ferramenta para gestão remota, oferecendo uma interface fácil de usar e suporte para múltiplos dispositivos. É indispensável para qualquer administrador de sistemas remoto que pretenda poupar tempo e aumentar a produtividade ao gerir a sua rede à distância.
